turns.userMessage:
Build a tall lighthouse on a rocky base: a rough wide base (about 8x8 studs, 2-3 bricks, dark grey), then a tapering tower in alternating red and white bands at least 14 bricks tall, topped by a glazed lantern room (trans-clear pieces) with a small roof. It must stand: keep the tower centered over the base as it tapers. Within a 10x10 stud footprint. 80-180 parts.
Constraints: footprint must fit within 10x10 studs; height at least 400 LDU (17 bricks); use at least 70 parts.
